title: Team pulse
description: This week's commits, and the weekly reports an agent wrote
howto: Write this week's pulse fills the Start with an ask for an agent: it reads the week's commits and keeps a report in the reports collection, which the page shows newest first.

state.week: The commits on the checked-out branch's first-parent line this week, newest first: sha, who, date, subject (a merge's or a squash's subject names its pull request, #12).
state.reports: A collection of filament.db: each week's pulse an agent wrote, { week, at, markdown }, the newest week last kept.
